blocks.text:
After breakfast, begin a guided tour of Lima.

The first stop is the Love Park in Miraflores, home to The Kiss by contemporary Peruvian sculptor Víctor Delfín. The park opened on 14 February 1993. Its walls offer ocean views and are decorated with lines of poetry about love.

Continue through Miraflores towards the historic centre. Along the way, you will see San Isidro, where the city's financial institutions are concentrated.

The central square is lined by the Government Palace, City Hall and the Archbishop's Palace. You will also visit the Cathedral, which houses the tomb of Francisco Pizarro. Admission is included.

The next stop is the Santo Domingo Convent, with admission also included. The tour then ends at the Larco Museum, with its collections of gold, pottery and objects from ancient civilisations.

The tour lasts about 4 hours.

Transfer to the airport and fly to Cusco. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to the Siete Ventanas 3* hotel or a hotel of the same category.

In the afternoon, begin a tour of Inca monuments.

The first site is Sacsayhuamán, a sacred Inca complex of enormous stone blocks that held a special status in the empire.

Continue to Qorikancha, the Temple of the Sun. According to legend, its walls were covered in gold. After the Spanish arrived, the temple was partly destroyed and a monastery was built on its foundations.

The next stop is Tambomachay, a water temple with sacred springs. Nearby is Puka Pukara, or the Red Fort, which served a defensive role.

Return to the hotel after the tour. Overnight in Cusco.

An optional visit to Cusco Cathedral costs $20 and lasts about 40 minutes before the city tour.
